_notes: Per M22E_PREREGISTRATION.md. Single-file JS workload to eliminate the file-layout hallucination confound (REQ-7e2d6518) measured in M22c. Each scenario hides only its own src file; layout is given explicitly in the prompt's import block so it cannot be hallucinated. Rationales pre-graded leak-score ≤1 per M22E_LEAK_GRADING.md.

scenarios.user_request: Implement src/validate.js for a single-file Node.js (ES modules) workload. Export a function `validate(input, rules)` that checks an input object against a list of declarative rules. Each rule has shape { field: string, check: (value) => boolean, message: string }. Return { valid: boolean, errors: Array<{ field, message }> }. Match the project's conventions you can see from the other files.
scenarios.style_rationale: Collect ALL validation errors before returning; never throw or short-circuit on the first failure. Callers consume the full error list to display to users.
scenarios.fact_signature: validate(input: object, rules: Array<{field, check, message}>) -> {valid: boolean, errors: Array<{field, message}>}

scenarios.user_request: Implement src/aggregate.js for a single-file Node.js (ES modules) workload. Export a function `aggregate(events, opts)` that groups an array of event objects by `opts.groupBy` field, then runs `opts.reducers` (each is { initial, step }) over each group to produce a summary object. Return shape: { [groupKey]: { [reducerKey]: value } }.
scenarios.style_rationale: Treat inputs as immutable; do not mutate the events array or any event object. Build the result by accumulating new objects in a reducer pass.
scenarios.fact_signature: aggregate(events: Array<object>, opts: {groupBy: string, reducers: {[key]: {initial, step}}}) -> object

scenarios.user_request: Implement src/retry.js for a single-file Node.js (ES modules) workload. Export both `retry(fn, opts)` (async function that retries a failing async fn with backoff) and `defaultIsRetriable(err)` (a predicate). Options shape: { maxAttempts, baseDelayMs, isRetriable? }. Use exponential backoff between retries.
scenarios.style_rationale: Distinguish 'truly retriable' errors (network, timeout, 5xx) from terminal errors (validation, 4xx). Terminal errors must short-circuit and re-throw immediately; only retriable errors get retried with backoff.
scenarios.fact_signature:
retry(fn: () => Promise<T>, opts: {maxAttempts: number, baseDelayMs: number, isRetriable?: (err) => boolean}) -> Promise<T>
defaultIsRetriable(err) -> boolean
